integrity: Exact formulas and all-range proofs supplied; finite checks are supportive only. Self-review is not independent verification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers the strict edge-fiber semigroup on complete multipartite graphs with at least three nonempty parts, not the full graph monoid; the asymptotic fixes each part size. Prior matching criterion and bipartite enumerations are credited; unindexed equivalent work remains possible.
title: Exact regularity census for strict graph semigroups of complete multipartite graphs
